scope_of_work.work_description: Complete tear-off and replacement of existing built-up gravel roof (BUR) with new 60-mil TPO single-ply roofing system across approximately 85,000 sq ft of low-slope industrial roof at 2550 Argentia Road, Mississauga. Includes deck inspection/repair, new R-30 polyiso insulation with cover board, all new flashings at 47 penetrations, drainage correction (resolve existing ponding), HVAC protection, and phased construction for an occupied pharmaceutical warehouse with cold-storage tenants.

membrane_system_specified.thickness_spec: Minimum 60 mil, white (minimum 80% solar reflectance), heat-welded seams (chemical seamers not acceptable)

included_items: Complete removal and legal disposal of existing roofing materials down to deck (membrane, gravel, insulation, flashings, adhesives)
Deck inspection and steel-deck repair (priced separately as unit pricing)
Installation of new TPO single-ply roofing system per Section 3
New rigid polyisocyanurate insulation, minimum R-30, two-layer staggered with cover board (1/4 inch gypsum or HD polyiso)
New flashings at all roof edges and 47 penetrations (12 HVAC, 8 plumbing vents, 6 electrical conduits, 4 skylights, 17 pipe penetrations, drains/scuppers)
Positive drainage to all roof drains; replace damaged drain bowls/leaders; resolve existing ponding via tapered insulation or additional drains
HVAC protection during construction with 72-hour minimum coordination notice for shutdowns
Daily and final cleanup; debris removal from site daily
Phased construction with no more than 15,000 sq ft exposed at any one time; each phase watertight at end of each work day
excluded_items: Asbestos-containing material (ACM) abatement costs (owner to fund actual abatement; bidders to include contingency planning in schedule per §2.3)
alternates_requested: Additional insulation above code minimum (price per R-value increment)
Infrared moisture survey of existing roof prior to removal
Tapered insulation system (price separately if not included in base) per §3.2
Wood deck replacement unit pricing (office wing) per §2.1.2
Steel deck repair unit pricing per §2.1.2

submission_requirements: Total bid price (lump sum) with HST indicated separately
Detailed breakdown of costs (materials, labour, disposal, etc.)
Product data sheets for all proposed materials
Project schedule with key milestones and phasing plan
Phasing plan describing approach to working in occupied building
Allowances (clearly identified with basis of estimate)

extraction_notes: Classified as obc_part_3: 85,000 sq ft industrial warehouse with occupied office and pharmaceutical cold-storage tenants — industrial occupancy AND footprint vastly exceeds the 600 m² Part 9 ceiling.
Roof type classified as low_slope_commercial: existing BUR being replaced with TPO single-ply (typical slope <2:12 for industrial warehouse).
Owner type set to private_commercial — Tenebrus Capital is a private capital firm; not a BPS entity, so BPS Procurement Directive does not apply.

Evaluation weighting consolidates RFP's 7 categories (Price 35 / Materials 20 / Warranty 15 / Schedule 12 / Qualifications 10 / Safety 5 / Value Engineering 3) into the schema's 6 buckets: technical_approach=23 (Materials 20 + Value Engineering 3), qualifications_certifications=5 (Safety only — Qualifications/References mapped to experience_references=10). Sums to 100. RFP-stated weights, not defaults.

Mandatory gates populated only where the RFP explicitly invokes them: WSIB clearance, CGL $5M, performance bond 50%, L&M bond 50%, mandatory site visit, 10 years in business, 3 similar references. RFP is SILENT on bid bond, addenda acknowledgment, non-collusion declaration, working-at-heights training cert, owner named as additional insured, and completed-operations period — these gates are deliberately left unpopulated to avoid disqualifying bidders for requirements the RFP never stated.
Pollution/Environmental Liability ($1M) is flagged as 'recommended' in §5.1.2 — NOT mandatory. Auto Liability $2M is required but no schema field exists; noted here for future reviewer awareness.
COR safety certification is 'preferred' per §5.1.5 / §5.2 — NOT mandatory. Bidders cannot be disqualified for lacking COR.

RFP DEFICIENCY (warranty type not specified): §3.1 and §9.6 require '20-year manufacturer warranty' but do not specify NDL vs material-only vs labour-and-material. Applied OBC Part 3 default of total_system_ndl (fixture 02 §1) so bidders compete on equivalent terms. OWNER FOLLOW-UP: confirm warranty type before bid evaluation; an addendum specifying NDL is recommended.

RFP DEFICIENCY (no wood-deck replacement allowance specified): §1.1 and §2.1.2 acknowledge wood deck sections in office wing of unknown condition and ask bidders to 'provide unit pricing,' but no board-foot allowance is carried in the base bid. OWNER FOLLOW-UP: extras for wood deck replacement could blow the budget; consider adding an allowance (e.g., 500 bf) so bids are comparable.

RFP DEFICIENCY (no manufacturer acceptable list): §3.1 specifies TPO 60-mil but does not name acceptable manufacturers (e.g., Carlisle, GAF, Firestone, Versico, Johns Manville). OWNER FOLLOW-UP: bidders may propose lower-tier manufacturers whose NDL warranty terms vary materially.
Cover board IS specified (§3.2 — 1/4 inch gypsum or HD polyiso required) — this is good practice for NDL-warranty validity per fixture 02 §1.

Designated Substances Assessment (DSA): building was constructed in 1998, so OHSA s.30 pre-1980 trigger does not apply by default. However, §2.3 acknowledges potential ACM and lead flashings during the 1998 transition period. OWNER FOLLOW-UP: a DSA may still be prudent given the §2.3 hazard caveat; current RFP does not require one before tender.
Liquidated damages of $500/calendar day per §9.5 noted but not captured in schema (no LD field).
